# Security Policy

Euphony takes the security of our application and users seriously.

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release version of Euphony is actively supported with security updates.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| v0.1.x  | Yes       |
| < 0.1.0 | No        |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in Euphony, please report it responsibly:

1. **Do NOT open a public GitHub issue** for security vulnerabilities.
2. Report vulnerabilities privately via [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/MohammedNihadv/Euphony/security/advisories/new) or contact the project maintainer.
3. Include details of the vulnerability, steps to reproduce, and any potential impact.

We will review your report within 48 hours and work with you to address and patch the issue promptly.

Thank you for helping keep Euphony and its community secure!
